+  function resizeCanvas() {
+    if (!canvasEl || !canvasWrapEl) return;
+
+    const rect = canvasWrapEl.getBoundingClientRect();
+    const cssW = Math.max(1, rect.width);
+    const cssH = Math.max(1, rect.height);
+
+    // Fit a 16:9 stage inside available space
+    let fitW = cssW;
+    let fitH = fitW / ASPECT;
+    if (fitH > cssH) {
+      fitH = cssH;

+    dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
+    canvasEl.style.width = `${fitW}px`;
+    canvasEl.style.height = `${fitH}px`;

+    W = Math.floor(fitW * dpr);
+    H = Math.floor(fitH * dpr);

+    canvasEl.width = W;
+    canvasEl.height = H;

+    [bgCanvas, boardCanvas, fxCanvas].forEach(c => {

+  function computeLayout() {
+    const pad = 6 * dpr;
+    const usableW = W - pad * 2;
+    const usableH = H - pad * 2;
+
+    // Board ratio is COLS/ROWS, but we keep the 16:9 stage with some margins
+    const boardRatio = COLS / ROWS;
+    let bw = usableW;
+    let bh = bw / boardRatio;
+    if (bh > usableH) {
+      bh = usableH;
+      bw = bh * boardRatio;
+    }

+    boardW = bw;
+    boardH = bh;
+    boardX = (W - bw) / 2;
+    boardY = (H - bh) / 2;
+
+    cellSize = boardH / ROWS;
+    holeR = cellSize * 0.58;
+  }

+  function drawRoundedRect(c, x, y, w, h, r) {
+    const rr = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
+    c.beginPath();
+    c.moveTo(x + rr, y);
+    c.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, rr);
+    c.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, rr);
+    c.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, rr);
+    c.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, rr);
+    c.closePath();
+  }

+  function updateParticles(dt) {

+  function updateAmbientParticles(dt) {

+  function renderChipsLayer(c, now) {
+    const cellW = boardW / COLS;

+
+    // draw placed chips (skip animating chip cell until animation ends)
+    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {

+      const eased = easeOutCubic(t);
+
+      const cx = boardX + (animChip.col + 0.5) * cellW;
+      const toY = boardY + (animChip.row + 0.5) * cellH;
+      let cy = lerp(animChip.fromY, toY, eased);
+
+      // bounce near end
+      if (t > 0.85) {
+        const bt = (t - 0.85) / 0.15;
+        cy = toY + Math.sin(bt * Math.PI) * (holeR * 0.18) * (1 - bt);
+      }
+
+      const rr = holeR * 0.92;
+      drawChipCore(c, cx, cy, rr, animChip.player, 1.1);
+      drawChipSymbol(c, cx, cy, rr, animChip.player);

+      // impact

+    }

+  function tick(now) {
+    if (!rendererReady) return;
+    const t = now || performance.now();
+    if (!tick._last) tick._last = t;
+    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (t - tick._last) / 1000);
+    tick._last = t;
+
+    // decay shaking
+    if (shaking > 0) shaking = Math.max(0, shaking - dt * 3.2);
+
+    if (ambientFx || needsRedraw || animChip || particles.length || hoverCol >= 0 || winningCells) {
+      drawFrame(t, dt);
+      needsRedraw = false;
+    }
+
+    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
+  }

+  function drawFrame(now, dt) {
+    if (!ctx) return;

+    const sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeMag;

+    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

+    // base layers
+    ctx.drawImage(bgCanvas, 0, 0);
+    ctx.save();

+    ctx.drawImage(boardCanvas, 0, 0);

+    // chips
+    renderChipsLayer(ctx, now);
+
+    ctx.restore();
+
+    // fx overlay
+    renderFxLayer(now, dt);
+    ctx.drawImage(fxCanvas, 0, 0);
+  }

+  function canvasPointToCol(clientX, clientY) {
+    if (!canvasEl) return -1;
+    const rect = canvasEl.getBoundingClientRect();
+    const x = clientX - rect.left;
+    const y = clientY - rect.top;
+    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x > rect.width || y > rect.height) return -1;
+
+    // Map CSS pixels -> internal layout (boardX is in device pixels)
+    const scaleX = (W / rect.width);
+    const scaleY = (H / rect.height);
+    const px = x * scaleX;
+    const py = y * scaleY;
+
+    if (px < boardX || px > boardX + boardW || py < boardY || py > boardY + boardH) return -1;
+    const col = Math.floor(((px - boardX) / boardW) * COLS);
+    return clamp(col, 0, COLS - 1);
+  }

+  height: 20px;
+  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);

+  animation: liquidWobble 3s ease-in-out infinite;
+}
+

+.bubble {

+  border-radius: 50%;
+  animation: rise 4s infinite linear;
+  bottom: -20px;
+}

+  box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--teal);

+.chip.p2 {
+  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #fff 0%, var(--toxic) 20%, #006b3f 100%);
+  box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--toxic);

+.chip::before { /* Thickness */

+  background: inherit; filter: brightness(0.6);

+@keyframes dropIn {
+  from { transform: translateY(-600px) rotateX(45deg); }
+  to { transform: translateY(0) rotateX(0deg); }

+.stat-card.active {
+  transform: scale(1.1);

+.stat-card.p2-active {
+  border-color: var(--toxic);
+  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(34, 255, 154, 0.2);

+.stat-label { font-size: 10px; color: #888; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; }
+.stat-val { font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 5px; }

+    </div>

+    </div>
+  </div>

+    <svg class="panel-border-svg" viewBox="0 0 260 400">
+       <rect x="1" y="1" width="258" height="398" rx="0" class="path-anim" />
+    </svg>
+    <div class="panel-header">SYSTEM LOG // LIVE FEED</div>
+    <div class="log-content" id="gameLog">
+      <div class="log-line">>> SYSTEM INITIALIZED</div>
+      <div class="log-line">>> BIO-LAB ENVIRONMENT LOADED</div>
+      <div class="log-line">>> WAITING FOR INPUT...</div>

+        </div>

+        <div class="liquid-fill" style="background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #ffb14a, #ff00ff)"></div>

+<script type="module">
+/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+   THREE.JS VISUAL ENGINE (Adapted from uploaded script.js)
+   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+import * as THREE from 'three';
+
+// Setup
+const canvas = document.getElementById('bg');
+const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, alpha: true });
+renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
+renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
+
+const scene = new THREE.Scene();
+scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x020203, 0.02); // Darker fog for KnXT theme
+
+const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 200);
+camera.position.set(0, 1, 8); // Lower angle
+
+// Lights
+const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x202038, 0x001020, 0.6);
+scene.add(hemi);
+const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
+dir.position.set(5, 10, 5);
+scene.add(dir);
+
+// Neon Light (The "Mutation Node" glow source)
+const neonLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x00f0ff, 2, 50);
+neonLight.position.set(0, 0, 2);
+scene.add(neonLight);
+
+// Particles
+const particleCount = 1000;
+const posArray = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);
+for(let i=0; i<particleCount * 3; i++) {
+  posArray[i] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 50;
+}
+const pGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
+pGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(posArray, 3));
+const pMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
+  color: 0x00f0ff,
+  size: 0.05,
+  transparent: true,
+  opacity: 0.8,
+  blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending
+});
+const particles = new THREE.Points(pGeo, pMat);
+scene.add(particles);
+
+// Lightning Effect (from uploaded script)
+const lightningGroup = new THREE.Group();
+scene.add(lightningGroup);
+
+function spawnLightning() {
+  if(Math.random() > 0.03) return; // Low chance
+  
+  const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20;
+  const z = -10 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
+  
+  const points = [];
+  let curY = 10;
+  let curX = x;
+  while(curY > -5) {
+    points.push(new THREE.Vector3(curX, curY, z));
+    curY -= Math.random() * 2;
+    curX += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
+  }
+  
+  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points);
+  const mat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00f0ff, opacity: 0.8, transparent: true });
+  const line = new THREE.Line(geo, mat);
+  lightningGroup.add(line);
+  
+  // Quick fade
+  setTimeout(() => {
+    lightningGroup.remove(line);
+    geo.dispose();
+    mat.dispose();
+  }, 100);
+}
+
+// Animation Loop
+function animate() {
+  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
+  
+  // Gentle particle float
+  particles.rotation.y += 0.0005;
+  const positions = pGeo.attributes.position.array;
+  for(let i=1; i<particleCount*3; i+=3) {
+    positions[i] += 0.01;
+    if(positions[i] > 20) positions[i] = -20;
+  }
+  pGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
+
+  spawnLightning();
+  
+  // Dynamic light color based on turn
+  const time = performance.now() * 0.001;
+  if(window.gameInstance && window.gameInstance.turn === 2) {
+    neonLight.color.lerp(new THREE.Color(0x22ff9a), 0.05);
+  } else {
+    neonLight.color.lerp(new THREE.Color(0x00f0ff), 0.05);
+  }
+
+  renderer.render(scene, camera);
+}
+animate();
+
+// Resize handler
+window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
+  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
+  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
+  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
+});
+
+</script>
+
+<script>
+class KnxtGame {
+  constructor() {
+    this.rows = 6;
+    this.cols = 7;
+    this.board = [];
+    this.turn = 1; // 1 = Teal, 2 = Toxic Green
+    this.scores = [0, 0];
+    this.active = true;
+    this.initDOM();
+    this.reset();
+    
+    // Global ref for Three.js access
+    window.gameInstance = this;
+    
+    // Bubbles
+    this.spawnBubbles();
+    
+    // Open Log panel
+    setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('sidePanel').classList.add('open'), 500);
+  }
+
+  initDOM() {
+    const grid = document.getElementById('grid');
+    grid.innerHTML = '';
+    for (let r = 0; r < this.rows; r++) {
+      for (let c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) {
+        const cell = document.createElement('div');
+        cell.className = 'cell';
+        cell.dataset.c = c;
+        cell.onclick = () => this.move(c);
+        grid.appendChild(cell);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  
+  spawnBubbles() {
+    const tubes = document.querySelectorAll('.tube');
+    tubes.forEach(tube => {
+      setInterval(() => {
+        const b = document.createElement('div');
+        b.className = 'bubble';
+        const size = 5 + Math.random() * 8;
+        b.style.width = size + 'px';
+        b.style.height = size + 'px';
+        b.style.left = (10 + Math.random() * 80) + '%';
+        b.style.animationDuration = (2 + Math.random() * 3) + 's';
+        tube.appendChild(b);
+        setTimeout(() => b.remove(), 5000);
+      }, 400);
+    });
+  }
+
+  reset() {
+    this.board = Array(this.rows).fill().map(() => Array(this.cols).fill(0));
+    this.turn = 1;
+    this.active = true;
+    document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(c => c.remove());
+    this.log(">> SYSTEM RESET. READY.");
+    this.updateHUD();
+  }
+
+  move(col) {
+    if (!this.active) return;
+    
+    // Find row
+    let row = -1;
+    for (let r = this.rows - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
+      if (this.board[r][col] === 0) {
+        row = r;
+        break;
+      }
+    }
+    if (row === -1) return; // Col full
+
+    // Update state
+    this.board[row][col] = this.turn;
+    
+    // Visuals
+    this.addChip(row, col);
+    this.shakeBoard();
+    this.log(`>> OP_${this.turn === 1 ? 'A' : 'X'} DROP: [${col},${row}]`);
+
+    // Win check
+    if (this.checkWin(row, col)) {
+      this.active = false;
+      this.scores[this.turn - 1]++;
+      this.log(`>> WIN DETECTED: OPERATOR ${this.turn === 1 ? 'A' : 'X'}`);
+      this.log(">> INITIATING RESET SEQUENCE...");
+      setTimeout(() => this.reset(), 2000);
+    } else {
+      this.turn = this.turn === 1 ? 2 : 1;
+      this.updateHUD();
+      
+      // Simple AI
+      if(this.turn === 2) {
+        setTimeout(() => {
+          const valid = [];
+          for(let c=0; c<7; c++) if(this.board[0][c]===0) valid.push(c);
+          if(valid.length) this.move(valid[Math.floor(Math.random()*valid.length)]);
+        }, 600);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  addChip(r, c) {
+    const grid = document.getElementById('grid');
+    const index = r * this.cols + c;
+    const cell = grid.children[index];
+    const chip = document.createElement('div');
+    chip.className = `chip p${this.turn}`;
+    cell.appendChild(chip);
+  }
+  
+  shakeBoard() {
+    const b = document.getElementById('boardContainer');
+    b.classList.remove('shake');
+    void b.offsetWidth;
+    b.classList.add('shake');
+  }
+
+  checkWin(r, c) {
+    const p = this.board[r][c];
+    const dirs = [[0,1], [1,0], [1,1], [1,-1]];
+    for(let [dr, dc] of dirs) {
+      let count = 1;
+      for(let i=1; i<4; i++) {
+        let nr = r + dr*i, nc = c + dc*i;
+        if(nr<0||nr>=this.rows||nc<0||nc>=this.cols||this.board[nr][nc]!==p) break;
+        count++;
+      }
+      for(let i=1; i<4; i++) {
+        let nr = r - dr*i, nc = c - dc*i;
+        if(nr<0||nr>=this.rows||nc<0||nc>=this.cols||this.board[nr][nc]!==p) break;
+        count++;
+      }
+      if(count >= 4) return true;
+    }
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  updateHUD() {
+    const c1 = document.getElementById('cardP1');
+    const c2 = document.getElementById('cardP2');
+    c1.classList.toggle('active', this.turn === 1);
+    c2.classList.toggle('active', false);
+    c2.classList.toggle('p2-active', this.turn === 2);
+    
+    document.getElementById('score1').innerText = this.scores[0];
+    document.getElementById('score2').innerText = this.scores[1];
+  }
+  
+  log(msg) {
+    const box = document.getElementById('gameLog');
+    const line = document.createElement('div');
+    line.className = `log-line ${this.turn === 1 ? 'p1' : 'p2'}`;
+    line.innerText = msg;
+    box.appendChild(line);
+    box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
+  }
+}
+
+// Init
+const game = new KnxtGame();
+
+// Global Menu Toggles
+window.toggleMenu = function(type) {
+  if(type === 'multiplayer') {
+     const btn = event.target;
+     if(btn.innerText.includes('OFF')) {
+       btn.innerText = 'MULTIPLAYER: SEARCHING...';
+       btn.classList.add('active');
+       game.log(">> NETWORK SCAN INITIATED...");
+       setTimeout(() => {
+          btn.innerText = 'MULTIPLAYER: ERROR (OFFLINE)';
+          btn.classList.remove('active');
+          game.log(">> CONNECTION FAILED. LOCAL MODE ACTIVE.");
+       }, 2000);
+     } else {
+       btn.innerText = 'MULTIPLAYER: OFF';
+       btn.classList.remove('active');
+     }
+  }
+  if(type === 'settings') {
+    game.log(">> ACCESS DENIED: PROTOCOL V6.0 LOCKED");
+  }
+};
+</script>
+</body>
+</html>
